intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to parks, lake-side walking paths, housing societies and institutions in Bhopal. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 640 km from the city. We send them by road and fix them on site with our installation team or a dealer, grouted into the ground or on a self-standing base.

Bhopal has a strong walking habit. Every morning people come out to the paths around the Upper Lake and the larger city gardens, and many government colonies have open green spaces in daily use. An open gym gives those walkers something more to do after a round. The machines run on the user's own body weight, so a retired officer and a college student can share a station without changing any settings.

sections.h: Where an open gym works in Bhopal
sections.html:
Three kinds of Bhopal site suit an outdoor gym well. Parks and lake-side stretches managed by civic bodies need machines that can take crowds at dawn and dusk. Residential townships on Kolar Road and other growing areas want a fitness corner beside the clubhouse or the jogging track. Colleges and government campuses often want a few stations near hostels or staff quarters.

Any of these can start small. Three or four stations along a walking path are enough to begin with, and more can be added later because each machine stands on its own footing. If the same garden needs a play area for children, see our playground equipment in Bhopal.

sections.h: Machines we suggest for Bhopal's walkers
sections.html:
For a mixed crowd, begin with low-impact stations. The Fun Walker Double lets two people swing their legs in a walking motion side by side. The Tai Chi Double works the shoulders and arms through slow circular movement, which older users find easy to pick up. A Seating Twister Three Way seats three people at once and loosens the waist and lower back.

Younger users usually want something harder. Once the first set is in regular use, add a press or a pull-up station, and we will show where it fits on the same layout drawing.

sections.h: Bhopal's weather and your outdoor gym
sections.html:
Summers in Bhopal are hot and dry, and a metal handle in the noon sun is uncomfortable to hold. Since most people exercise early and late in the day, drainage matters more than shade here. The monsoon, from June to September, brings heavy rain, and a machine standing in a puddle wears faster at its base. Set the stations on a level, slightly raised platform that sheds water.

The frames are galvanised pipe, which carries our 3-year warranty, and bearings carry a 1-year warranty. Check moving parts after the rains and follow the maintenance steps we give you at handover.

faq.q: Do you supply and install outdoor gym equipment in Bhopal?
faq.a: Yes. We make the Fun Fitness range at our Vasai factory, send it to Bhopal by road and install it through our own team or a dealer. Whether a machine is grouted or self-standing depends on your ground.

faq.q: How many machines does a park or society need to begin with?
faq.a: Three or four stations are a sensible start for most walking paths. Tell us roughly how many people use the space each morning and share the size of the area, and we will suggest a mix with the clear space each machine needs.

faq.q: Are the machines suitable for older users?
faq.a: Many of them are. Walkers, tai chi wheels and seated twisters are low impact and use the person's own body weight. Place a few benches nearby so people can rest between stations; we make these in our garden decor range.

faq.q: Can one layout cover an outdoor gym and a children's play area?
faq.a: Yes. Many parks put the two side by side so parents can exercise while children play within sight. We make both, and we can mark the gym stations and the safe play area on a single drawing.

intro: Chennai's walkers are out before sunrise, on the beach promenades, in neighbourhood parks and on the tracks inside residential complexes. FunPlay Systems supplies the outdoor gym equipment that goes beside those paths. We make our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,050 km away, and bring them to Chennai by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

The buyers we work with in Chennai include apartment associations, IT and corporate campuses along OMR, schools and colleges, and the civic bodies that run public parks. Each wants something a little different. An association wants a compact corner that residents of every age can use, while a campus wants stations that young staff will find challenging. We help you choose machines for the people who will actually turn up.

sections.h: Salt air, humidity and the northeast monsoon
sections.html:
Chennai is humid all year, and sites close to the sea, such as those along ECR, collect a fine layer of salt on every surface. Our frames are galvanised pipe, where a zinc coating protects the steel underneath. A rinse with fresh water every few weeks stops salt from building up around joints and handles.

The heavy rain arrives with the northeast monsoon between October and December, and low-lying plots flood quickly. Fix the machines on a raised, paved platform with a drainage slope rather than on bare earth. Galvanised pipes carry a 3-year warranty and bearings carry 1 year, as long as the equipment is maintained as per our instructions.

sections.h: Strength stations for campuses and colleges
sections.html: Younger users on an OMR campus or a college ground tend to walk past the gentle machines. For them we suggest strength stations. The Pull Up Station and the Parallel Bar are used for pull-ups, dips and leg raises. A Cross Fit station adds more strength work for a group training together during a break. These take little floor space, so they fit beside a basketball court or along the edge of a sports ground.

sections.h: Apartment associations and senior residents
sections.html:
In a residential complex the morning crowd is often older and the evening crowd younger. A set of four stations can serve both if you mix low-impact machines with one or two strength pieces. The Fun Rower works the arms, back and legs in a seated rowing motion and suits most ages. Add a walker and a seated twister, and leave a clear zone around each machine.

If the same complex needs a children's area, see our playground equipment in Chennai. We can plan both on one drawing.

faq.q: Do you deliver outdoor gym equipment from Vasai to Chennai?
faq.a: Yes. The machines are made at our Vasai factory and travel to Chennai by road. Our installation team or a dealer then fixes them on your site, grouted into the ground or self-standing, depending on the surface.

faq.q: How do I protect open gym equipment from Chennai's sea air?
faq.a: Choose galvanised frames, rinse them with fresh water every few weeks, and check bolts and moving parts after the monsoon. We share a maintenance checklist at handover, and following it keeps the warranty valid.

faq.q: Have you worked on projects in Tamil Nadu?
faq.a: Yes. One example is a resort playground we installed in Dindigul. For an outdoor gym in Chennai, send us your site details and we will prepare a layout for your space.

faq.q: What details do you need to quote for an outdoor gym?
faq.a: The length and width of the area, the type of ground, a few photos and an idea of who will use it. We then suggest machines, send a layout drawing with the clear space marked and share the quote.

intro: FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor gym equipment at our factory in Vasai East, in the Palghar district of Maharashtra. We have made play and fitness equipment since 2002 for parks, housing societies, schools, colleges and corporate campuses, and our work covers more than 15,000 installations across India. Our outdoor gym range is called Fun Fitness and sits within our CoreCraft line.

Every machine is made in our 45,000 sq ft facility by a team of 150+ people, who fabricate the galvanised frames and inspect each piece before dispatch. We send equipment by road to any state and install it with our own team or one of our dealers in the north, south, east and west of India. Wherever your site is, the steps stay the same. You share the size and photos, we send a layout drawing, and we manufacture once you approve it.

sections.h: Outdoor gyms for every Indian climate
sections.html:
An open gym in Kochi faces a very different year from one in Jaipur or Shimla. Coastal cities bring salt air and humidity, and the Northeast and the Western Ghats bring months of heavy rain. The northern plains swing from fierce summers to foggy winters, while the desert belt adds dust and strong sun. Galvanised frames handle all of these well, because the zinc coating protects the steel from rust.

What changes from region to region is the base. Wet regions need a raised, well-drained platform, while dusty ones need moving parts wiped and checked more often. Our warranty is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts, for equipment installed and maintained as per our instructions.

sections.h: Choosing machines for your site
sections.html:
Municipal corporations usually want sturdy stations along walking tracks and in public parks. Housing societies want a compact corner, and schools, colleges and industrial townships want strength stations for younger users. The full Fun Fitness range covers each of these.

Where space is tight, an 8 Station Multi Gym or a 6 Station Multi Gym groups several exercises around one structure. Combination machines such as the Leg Press Cum Pendulum put two exercises on one frame. For a long walking track, single stations spaced along the path spread the crowd better. Tell us who will use the gym and we will suggest the mix.

faq.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to every state in India?
faq.a: Yes. All equipment is made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and sent by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer, and we have dealers in all four regions of India.

faq.q: What warranty comes with your outdoor gym equipment?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

faq.q: Do outdoor gym machines need electricity or adjustment?
faq.a: No. Our Fun Fitness machines work on the user's own body weight, so there is nothing to plug in or set. That makes them easy to use for walkers, students and senior citizens alike.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for an outdoor gym?
faq.a: Call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com with the size of the area, photos and the expected users. We will suggest machines and send a layout drawing with the quote.

intro: Navi Mumbai is one of the closest cities to our factory. FunPlay Systems makes its outdoor gym equipment in Vasai East, about 40 km away, so machines for Vashi, Nerul, Belapur or Kharghar reach you after a short road trip. Our own installation team or a dealer then fixes them on site, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

The city was planned in nodes, and most of them have sector gardens, jogging tracks and housing societies with some open ground. That suits small outdoor gyms placed where people already walk, and residents here tend to use them daily once they are in. We supply our Fun Fitness machines to societies, schools, colleges, corporate offices and civic gardens. Every layout is planned around the space you actually have, even when that is a narrow strip beside a compound wall.

sections.h: Planning for a Konkan monsoon
sections.html:
Navi Mumbai gets very heavy rain from June to September, and sites near the creek stay humid for most of the year. Water collects fast on flat society plots and podiums, so fix the machines on a raised, paved base with a clear drainage slope. Galvanised frames resist rust, but standing water still wears the base plates over time.

Before we suggest grouting or a self-standing base, we look at photos of your ground. After every monsoon, check bolts and moving parts and grease them as per the steps we share at handover. Bearings carry a 1-year warranty and galvanised pipes carry 3 years.

sections.h: Stations that suit a society garden
sections.html:
Society gardens in Navi Mumbai are often compact, so each station has to earn its place. The Ski Trainer gives a full-body cardio movement on a small footprint. The Step Trainer works the legs in a stepping motion and is easy for beginners. A Chest Press Double lets two residents train the upper body at the same time, which helps during the busy morning hour.

Three machines like these, with a bench or two, already make a usable fitness corner for a mid-sized society.

sections.h: Work close to Navi Mumbai
sections.html: Being this close to Vasai helps when you want to compare options before ordering, and it keeps transport simple for a small order of two or three machines. Our projects in the region include work for Raymond in Thane. To start, share the length and width of your area, a few photos and the age group of the people who will use it. We send a layout drawing with clear space marked around each machine, and production starts once you approve the layout and the quote.

faq.q: Do you install outdoor gym equipment in Navi Mumbai?
faq.a: Yes. Our factory in Vasai East is about 40 km away. We send the machines by road and install them with our own team or a dealer, grouted into the ground or self-standing.

faq.q: Can outdoor gym machines go on a podium or terrace?
faq.a: Often they can, using a self-standing base so the slab does not need drilling. Share photos and the slab details with us, and we will tell you which machines and which base method suit the space.

faq.q: How much space does a small society gym need?
faq.a: It depends on the machines you pick, since some need clear space for swinging movement. Send us the size of the area and we will mark each station and its clear zone on a layout drawing.

faq.q: Whom do I call for repairs after installation?
faq.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Galvanised pipes carry a 3-year warranty and bearings and spare parts 1 year, for manufacturing defects.

intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment across Odisha, from Bhubaneswar, Cuttack and Puri on the coast to Sambalpur and Rourkela in the west of the state. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, and travel to Odisha by road. Our installation team or a dealer then fixes them on site, grouted into the ground or on a self-standing base.

Open gyms in Odisha usually go into municipal parks, lake and river walkways, industrial townships and college campuses. The users range from early morning walkers to students and plant staff coming off a shift. We suggest a mix of stations for the people who will use the space, and we send a layout drawing with the clear space marked before anything is made. Each station stands on its own footing, so a town can begin with a few and add more as people start using them.

sections.h: Coastal and western Odisha need different planning
sections.html:
Along the coast, from Balasore to Berhampur, the air is humid and salty, the southwest monsoon is heavy and the Bay of Bengal brings cyclones. Equipment here should be grouted on exposed sites and set on a well-drained base. A fresh-water rinse now and then keeps salt off the joints. For the capital, see our outdoor gym equipment in Bhubaneswar.

Western Odisha, around Sambalpur, Jharsuguda and Rourkela, has hotter and drier summers, with more dust in the air. There, moving parts need wiping and checking more often, and a morning shade line helps users in May and June.

sections.h: Machines for parks, townships and campuses
sections.html:
Steel and mining towns often have planned townships with large open grounds, where staff want strength work. The Leg Press Double trains the legs for two users at once, and the Fun Rider gives a seated push and pull movement for the arms and legs. Municipal parks do well with gentler walkers and twisters spaced along the track, since their users are often older and come in for a short session after a walk.

Galvanised pipes carry our 3-year warranty and bearings carry 1 year. For a children's area in the same park, see our playground equipment in Odisha.

faq.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to all parts of Odisha?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory by road to coastal and inland towns alike, and install it with our own team or a dealer. Share your site location and we will plan the dispatch.

faq.q: Will open gym equipment survive a cyclone season on the Odisha coast?
faq.a: Grouting the machines into a firm base gives them the best hold on exposed coastal sites. After any severe storm, inspect bolts and moving parts and call our after-sales team if anything looks loose or damaged.

faq.q: Which machines suit an industrial township?
faq.a: A mix of strength machines such as leg presses, chest presses and pull-up stations for younger staff, with a few walkers and twisters for families. We can suggest a set based on the size of the ground.

faq.q: What do you need from us to prepare a layout?
faq.a: The length and width of the area, the type of ground, a few photos and who will use it. We return a layout drawing with clear space marked and a quote for your approval.

intro: Raipur is hot for a large part of the year, so most people here exercise outdoors early in the morning or after sunset. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment for those hours, to parks, lakefronts, housing colonies, schools and industrial campuses in and around the city. We make our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai East, about 930 km away, and send them to Raipur by road.

Installation is done by our own team or a dealer, either grouted into the ground or on a self-standing base. Several kinds of Raipur site suit an open gym. Think of lake-side walkways such as the one at Telibandha, residential sectors in Nava Raipur, and the staff colonies of plants in the industrial areas around the city. Each needs a different mix of machines, and we plan that with you before anything is made.

sections.h: Heat, dust and the monsoon in Chhattisgarh
sections.html:
Raipur's summer is fierce from April until the rains arrive, and the monsoon from June to September is heavy. Dust settles on equipment in the dry months, and rain then washes it into the moving parts. Wipe handles and pivots regularly, and check bearings once the monsoon ends.

Place the machines where a building or a row of trees throws shade in the early morning and evening, and set them on a slightly raised base so rainwater drains away. Galvanised frames carry our 3-year warranty, and bearings carry 1 year, as long as the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

sections.h: Stations for plant colonies and college grounds
sections.html:
Younger users in a plant colony or a college want machines that feel like real training. The ABB Trainer works the core and stomach muscles. The Leg Extension builds the thigh muscles from a seated position. A Pendulum Double gives two people a swinging movement for the hips and waist, and needs clear space on both sides.

These three stand well next to a pull-up station on a sports ground. Leave a clear zone around each one so that a person on the pendulum never swings into someone on the next machine.

sections.h: A simple start for colony gardens
sections.html: A residential colony does not need a large budget to begin. Three or four stations along an existing walking path will see daily use, and you can add more as residents ask for them, because each machine sits on its own footing. Send us the length and width of the space and a few photos, and we will send a layout drawing. For children in the same garden, see our playground equipment in Raipur.

faq.q: Do you install outdoor gym equipment in Raipur and Nava Raipur?
faq.a: Yes. We dispatch the machines from our Vasai factory by road and install them with our own team or a dealer, grouted or self-standing, depending on the ground at your site.

faq.q: How should outdoor gym equipment be maintained in Raipur's dust?
faq.a: Wipe handles and moving joints regularly in the dry months and inspect the bearings after the monsoon. We give you a maintenance checklist at handover, and following it keeps the warranty valid.

faq.q: Can a college or company order a custom set of machines?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us how many people will use the gym at one time and what kind of training they want. We will suggest a set of stations and show them on a layout drawing before you place the order.

faq.q: What warranty do you offer on outdoor gym equipment?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

intro: Ahmedabad summers are long and very hot, and that one fact shapes most of the playground advice we give here. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, builders, housing societies and public gardens in the city. Our factory is in Vasai East, about 410 km away, and we send the finished equipment to Ahmedabad by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

New residential projects along SG Highway, in Bopal, Shela and Gota, and across the western edge of the city usually want a play area ready before possession. Schools want equipment for several age groups on one ground, and the gardens of the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation need pieces that can take heavy evening crowds. We plan each of these from the site size, the age group and a few photos you share.

sections.h: Planning a playground for Ahmedabad's heat
sections.html:
Any surface left in the afternoon sun gets hot, so start with orientation. Face slide beds away from the western sun, and place the main play structure where a building or trees shade it after lunch. Our garden decor range includes gazebos and pergolas that give shade to waiting parents as well.

Colour matters too. Dark shades absorb more heat, so pick lighter tones from our 15+ roto-moulded colour shades for slides and decks. Roto-moulded plastic does not rust, and galvanised steel holds up through dusty summers and the short monsoon from June to September. Wipe the dust off before children play after a dry, windy spell.

sections.h: What builders and societies usually choose
sections.html:
A builder wants a play area that looks good in the sales brochure and fits a set plot. Our Play Lands multi play stations combine slides, climbers and decks in one structure, so a small footprint can keep a group of children busy. Housing societies that already have a structure often add individual pieces later, such as a swing set or a spring rider for toddlers.

For a society that also wants fitness equipment for adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Ahmedabad.

sections.h: Schools and public gardens
sections.html: School grounds and municipal gardens see far more children per day than a society play area, so we suggest pieces that let many children play together. Our Khel Khud collection, designed by our own team, draws on Indian games and works well where groups of children arrive at once. Separate the equipment for younger and older children so that each group has its own safe play area.

sections.h: From layout to installation
sections.html: Send us the length and width of the site, the age group and photos. We suggest equipment and return a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. After you approve the layout and the quote, we manufacture at Vasai, dispatch by road and install, self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Through each stage we keep you updated on progress.

faq.q: Do you supply and install playground equipment in Ahmedabad?
faq.a: Yes. We make the equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 410 km away, send it to Ahmedabad by road and install it through our own team or a dealer.

faq.q: How do I keep slides from getting too hot in summer?
faq.a: Face the slide away from the afternoon sun, choose a lighter colour and plan shade from trees, a building or a pergola. Most children play in the morning and evening in the hottest months anyway.

faq.q: Can you handle a playground for a new residential project?
faq.a: Yes. Share the plot size and the possession timeline, and we will suggest equipment that fits. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked so your architect can place it on the site plan.

faq.q: What warranty do you give in Ahmedabad?
faq.a: The same as everywhere in India. Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, for manufacturing defects.

intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, towns and institutions across Arunachal Pradesh, from Itanagar and Naharlagun to district headquarters deep in the hills. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra. It travels to the state by road, and our installation team or a dealer sets it up on site, grouted or self-standing.

Arunachal is a long way from Vasai and much of the state is hill country, so a project here needs more planning before dispatch than a city job on the plains. We ask for clear photos of the site, details of the road a truck can use to reach it and a description of the ground. With that, we can suggest equipment that fits the plot, plan the parts that need to travel, and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Rain, slopes and cold in the hills
sections.html:
Arunachal gets heavy rain through a long monsoon, and hill roads can close for days after landslides. Where you can, schedule dispatch and installation for the drier months after the rains. Most hill sites need a levelled terrace with a retaining edge and a clear drainage channel, because water running off the slope will otherwise wash out the base. Grouting is usually the better method on such ground.

Higher towns such as Tawang get cold winters. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle both the wet and the cold well, since plastic does not rust and the zinc coating protects the steel.

sections.h: Who buys playground equipment in Arunachal
sections.html:
Government and residential schools are the main buyers in the state, followed by town parks and the campuses of defence and paramilitary forces. Hotels and homestays in tourist towns such as Ziro also add small play areas for visiting families, usually one compact structure on a lawn. For the capital region, see our page on playground equipment in Itanagar.

Schools often ask for pieces that many children can use at once. Our Organic Play structures, inspired by nature, suit a green hill campus. For adults and staff, see our outdoor gym equipment in Arunachal Pradesh.

faq.q: Can you deliver playground equipment to remote towns in Arunachal Pradesh?
faq.a: We send equipment by road from our Vasai factory. For remote hill towns, tell us the route and any limits on truck size, and we will plan the dispatch and installation with you before production.

faq.q: Which installation method suits a hill site?
faq.a: Grouting into a levelled, well-drained base is usually the safer choice on sloping or loose ground. We decide the method after seeing photos of the site and the ground.

faq.q: Do the materials hold up in heavy rain?
faq.a: Yes. Roto-moulded plastic does not rust and galvanised steel is protected by its zinc coating. A raised base with good drainage keeps water away from the footings during the long monsoon.

faq.q: What warranty applies in Arunachal Pradesh?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Limited reliable local knowledge on buyers in Arunachal; kept to schools, town parks, defence campuses and tourist-town hotels. Road access and best dispatch season should be confirmed by FunPlay for real projects.

intro: Assam gets more rain than most of India, and a playground here has to cope with wet ground for months at a stretch. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing societies, parks, tea estates and institutions across the state. Our factory is in Vasai East, Maharashtra, and we send equipment to Assam by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

Guwahati has most of the state's apartment projects and large private schools. Towns in Upper Assam, such as Jorhat, Dibrugarh and Tinsukia, have schools, clubs and estate colonies of their own, and the Barak Valley around Silchar is a separate market again. Each area has its own mix of buyers. Wherever your site is, we start from its size, the age group of the children and a few photos, then send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Planning for the Brahmaputra valley's rain
sections.html:
The monsoon in Assam starts early and runs long, and low-lying areas flood in most years. Raise the play area above the surrounding ground and give it a drainage slope, so water runs off instead of pooling under the equipment. Rubber flooring on that raised base dries faster than soil and cushions falls, and we supply it with the equipment.

Humidity also brings moss and algae on shaded surfaces. Scrub decks and steps from time to time so they do not turn slippery. Roto-moulded plastic does not rust, and galvanised steel posts are protected by their zinc coating, which is why we use both throughout our ranges.

sections.h: Supplying Guwahati, Upper Assam and the Barak Valley
sections.html:
In Guwahati, builders and housing societies usually want a compact multi play system for a podium or garden. Schools across the state want equipment for several age groups on one ground, with separate zones for the youngest children. See our pages for Guwahati and Silchar for city details.

Tea estate schools and colonies often have open land but little shade, so plan trees or a gazebo beside the play area. Nature-themed pieces from our Nature Sparsh collection fit that green setting well. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Assam.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment across Assam?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from our Vasai factory to Guwahati and other towns in the state, and install it through our own team or a dealer, grouted or self-standing.

faq.q: What surface works best under play equipment in a flood-prone area?
faq.a: Rubber flooring on a raised, well-drained base. It cushions falls, dries faster than soil after rain and keeps children off mud. We can supply it along with the equipment.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground for a tea estate school?
faq.a: Yes. Share the size of the ground, the age groups and photos. We will suggest pieces that suit a large group of children and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

faq.q: What warranty do you give on playground equipment?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.

intro: Many play areas in Bangalore are built on a podium slab between apartment towers rather than on open ground. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these gated communities, and for schools, parks and corporate campuses across the city. We make everything at our factory in Vasai East, about 870 km away, and send it to Bangalore by road.

Our installation team or a local dealer sets up the equipment on your site. The large residential projects along Sarjapur Road, Whitefield, Hebbal, Electronic City and Kanakapura Road each need a play area for several age groups, often on a fixed plot shown in the brochure. International and CBSE schools want equipment that takes a full school day of use. We help with both, from the first layout drawing to installation.

sections.h: Podium and terrace play areas
sections.html:
On a podium, the waterproofing below the slab must not be damaged, so drilling deep into it is usually not an option. In these cases we install the equipment self-standing, on a base that spreads the load, instead of grouting it. Share the slab details and photos with us early, so your structural consultant can check the load before we finalise the layout.

Rubber flooring is the usual surface on a podium. It cushions falls and protects the slab, and we supply it along with the equipment. Keep a strip of open floor between the play zone and any planters or water features, so children running off a slide have room to stop.

sections.h: Year-round play in a mild climate
sections.html:
Bangalore's weather lets children play outdoors in almost every month, which means the equipment sees more hours of use than in hotter cities. Heavy showers come with the southwest monsoon and again in October and November, so the play area still needs a drainage slope. Water left standing on a podium can also find its way through joints in the waterproofing, which is one more reason to keep the surface draining well.

Plan a monthly check of bolts, swing hangers and spring riders, and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry a 3-year warranty, and springs and bearings carry 1 year.

sections.h: Equipment for gated communities and schools
sections.html:
Large communities with a big central lawn often choose a feature structure from our NexLev Series, which includes our newer, larger play towers and wooden structures. Schools that want something different from the usual slide and swing look at our Kagzi structures, inspired by paper folding. Buyers on the city's southern edge can also see our page for Hosur.

For residents who want fitness equipment too, see our outdoor gym equipment in Bangalore.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a podium slab?
faq.a: Yes. We use a self-standing method that does not need deep drilling into the slab. Share the slab details and photos so your consultant can confirm the load before we finalise the layout.

faq.q: Do you deliver and install in Bangalore?
faq.a: Yes. We make the equipment at our Vasai factory, about 870 km away, send it by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

faq.q: How do you plan a play area for different age groups?
faq.a: We separate toddler pieces such as spring riders and low slides from the larger structures meant for older children. Each zone gets its own safe play area on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Can you match the colours to our project?
faq.a: Yes. Our roto-moulded parts come in 15+ colour shades, and design customisation is possible on request. Tell us your colour scheme when you share the site details.
